description: Bundle FFmpeg binaries for Windows in the app package. Extend ffmpeg.ts discovery to find bundled ffmpeg.exe in vendor/win32/ or app.asar.unpacked. Include only needed codecs (libx264, libvpx, aac, pcm) to minimize bundle size. Handle PATH-installed FFmpeg as fallback. Verify ffmpeg probe works correctly with Windows paths (backslashes, spaces in Program Files).
title: Windows FFmpeg bundling and discovery
